name: agent-workbench
description: 可私有化部署的多 Agent 工作台

scripts.predev: npm run design:sync && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/contracts && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/runtime && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/persistence
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,persistence,api,runner,web "npm run dev --workspace @agent-workbench/contracts" "npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/persistence -- --watch" "npm run dev --workspace @agent-workbench/api" "npm run dev --workspace @agent-workbench/runner" "npm run dev --workspace @agent-workbench/web"
scripts.build: npm run design:sync && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/contracts && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/runtime && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/persistence && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/runner && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/api && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/contracts && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/runtime && npm run build --workspace @agent-workbench/persistence && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run figma:typecheck && npm run build
